capstones.title: Shema capstone
capstones.prompt: Explain how one Torah line becomes prayer, a practical Mishnah question, and a Gemara argument. Name one new role added at each stage.

capstones.title: Blessings capstone
capstones.prompt: Explain how the source chain moves from gratitude to communal practice and reasoning. State the boundary between study and personal ruling.

capstones.title: Tefillah capstone
capstones.prompt: Compare praise, petition, and thanks. Explain how Torah language enters the service without losing its original setting.

capstones.title: Freedom capstone
capstones.prompt: Define agency, state one source-grounded claim about it, and name the tension the sources hold together.

capstones.title: History and Wider World capstone
capstones.prompt: Explain how audience, place, institution, and translation affect responsible comparison across communities.

capstones.title: Responsibility capstone
capstones.prompt: Explain how character, intention, historical setting, and public responsibility connect without becoming a personal ruling.
